# NinoPad (奶猫妙控)

> NinoPad (奶猫妙控) is a customizable Mac control deck and secondary keypad for iPhone and iPad.
> It turns mobile devices into tactile control consoles with real-time desktop mirroring, trackpad, custom dials, AI coding companion (Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity), native Shell terminal, video editing shortcuts, and wireless microphone.

Website: https://ninopad.com
English Site: https://ninopad.com/en/
iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6805378609
Mac App: https://github.com/buggyblues/ninopad/releases/latest
Game Hall: https://arcade.ninopad.com/

## System Requirements & Architecture
- macOS: macOS 13 (Ventura) and later (Universal binary for Apple Silicon M1-M4 and Intel).
- iOS / iPadOS: iOS 17.0+ and iPadOS 17.0+.
- Connection: Pure local Wi-Fi peer-to-peer connection via Bonjour protocol. Zero cloud relay, zero account registration, privacy-first.
- Permissions: Mac Accessibility for keystroke/mouse injection; macOS Screen Recording for optional screen stream.

## Core Feature Guides (English)
- [Work Deck Starter](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-work): Trackpad navigation, typing, and clipboard actions.
- [AI Coding & Codex Deck](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-codex): Multi-agent slot inspection, preview, and reasoning effort dials.
- [Terminal Monitor](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-terminal): Manage native macOS Shell sessions on mobile.
- [Creative Studio](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-creative): Timeline jog shuttle and hotkeys for DaVinci Resolve, FCP, CapCut.
- [Synthesizer Starter](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/guide-synthesizer): 7 diatonic chord keys, filter knobs, drum beats, 6-track loops.
- [Guitar Starter](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/guide-guitar): Capacitive strings, joystick chords, 100 interactive lessons.
- [Arcade Gamepad](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-arcade): Use mobile touchscreen as wireless gamepad for Mac party games.
- [Smart Home Deck](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-smart-home): Connect Home Assistant entities with physical-feel knobs.
- [App Launcher](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-launcher): Bring favorite Mac apps frontmost from phone icons.
- [Web Browser Helper](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-browser): Direct URL navigation, tab sliders, and in-page search.
- [Finance & Formulas](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-finance): Numeric keypad, local calculator, and 64 formula helpers.
- [Focused Writing](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-writing): 4-tier cursor navigation and Markdown formatting.
- [Research Workflow](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-research): Capture snippets, notes, and citations.
- [Deep Reading](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-reading): Turn PDF pages with dual knobs and jump chapters.
- [Palm Sampler](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/layout-sampler): Live audio recording, auto-slicing, and 16 drum pads.
- [Custom Keypad](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/custom-keypad): Build custom action buttons, step macros, and dials.
- [Mac Pairing & Permissions](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/mac-settings): Step-by-step checklist for pairing and macOS permissions.
- [Presentation Suite](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/presentation-tools): Motion laser pointer, teleprompter, and soundboard.
- [Remote Mac Control](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/remote-control-mac): Stream desktop in native aspect ratio with trackpad.
- [Voice & Text Input](https://ninopad.com/en/blog/voice-text-input): Dictate or pre-edit text on phone, send to Mac cursor.

## 中文核心功能指南 (Chinese Guides)
- [工作台副控入门](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-work): 触控板导航、打字与剪贴板操作。
- [Codex 与氛围编程](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-codex): 多 Agent 任务切换、回读与推理旋钮。
- [终端会话随身控](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-terminal): 管理 Mac 原生 Shell 终端会话。
- [应用创作台](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-creative): 剪映、DaVinci Resolve、Final Cut Pro 剪辑调色。
- [合成器入门](https://ninopad.com/blog/guide-synthesizer): 七级和弦键、旋钮调音与鼓点变体。
- [吉他入门](https://ninopad.com/blog/guide-guitar): 感应琴弦、摇杆和弦与 100 首互动曲谱。
- [游戏大厅手柄](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-arcade): 手机化身触屏手柄联机畅玩。
- [智能家居副控](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-smart-home): 接入 Home Assistant 实体旋钮调光。
- [常用应用启动器](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-launcher): 常用应用大图标快速切至前台。
- [浏览器副控](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-browser): 掌上直达网址与滑块切标签。
- [财务与表格计算](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-finance): 数字键盘与 64 个常用公式构建。
- [专注文字写作](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-writing): 四级光标范围与 Markdown 排版。
- [知识摘录工作流](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-research): 选区摘录、备忘与出处沉淀。
- [深度阅读辅助](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-reading): PDF 旋钮翻页与章节目录跳转。
- [采样工作站](https://ninopad.com/blog/layout-sampler): 实时录音采样与 16 格鼓垫演奏。
- [小键盘定制](https://ninopad.com/blog/custom-keypad): 自由定制按键、多步宏与旋钮。
- [首次连接与权限排查](https://ninopad.com/blog/mac-settings): 辅助功能、屏幕录制与局域网排查。
- [演示辅助利器](https://ninopad.com/blog/presentation-tools): 虚拟激光笔、智能提词器与音效。
- [远程控制 Mac 桌面](https://ninopad.com/blog/remote-control-mac): 实时画面镜像与虚拟触控板。
- [语音转文字与文本输入](https://ninopad.com/blog/voice-text-input): 手机口述预编辑，一键整段发送。
